name: MoonSweeper+
author: MSML
description:
The official MSML quality-of-life mod: small fixes for everyday annoyances. Every fix can be turned on or off with SETTINGS (here, or MOD SETTINGS in the pause menu).

Vehicle camera: the camera stays where you point it while driving instead of snapping back behind the vehicle. Turn on auto recenter to bring the snap-back back, with your own delay.

Capsule limit: a moon normally holds at most 10,000 capsules (counting every capsule on belts); at the limit nothing can pack capsules. Raise it up to 100,000 in SETTINGS. More capsules cost frame rate, so raise it gradually. In a crew the host's limit is used.
